description: Defines a template class 'executor_tracer' that wraps a task executor to add tracing of task enqueuing and execution times, including specializations for null tracers and factory functions for creating traced executors.

classes.name: executor_tracer
classes.description: A task executor that traces latencies of task enqueuing and invocation, templated over executor and tracer types.

classes.name: executor_tracer<Exec, detail::null_event_tracer>
classes.description: Specialization of executor_tracer for null event tracer that adds no overhead.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Overrides task execution to include tracing of enqueue and run times.

methods.name: defer
methods.description: Overrides task deferring to include tracing of enqueue and run times.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Helper template functions to obtain references from various pointer or reference types.

methods.name: make_trace_executor
methods.description: Factory function to create an executor_tracer instance.
